heroTitle: Happy Start with HappyMom, Service Application Procedure
heroSubtitle: From consultation to service start, HappyMom systematically helps for the mother's comfortable recovery.
step01Desc: Please call the contact number at the bottom of the HappyMom website or apply for a consultation through the Contact page. We will conduct the first consultation after checking the mother's expected delivery date and region.
step02Title: Step 02. Detailed Service Explanation and Decision
step02Desc: Receive a detailed explanation of the service through a 1:1 consultation with the HappyMom director. Finalize the service that is most suitable for the mother's health status and family environment.
step03Desc: We will send you a contract drafted based on the consultation contents. After reviewing carefully, simply submit the completed contract by email (happymom7080@gmail.com).
step04Desc: Send the deposit to confirm the reservation. Payment can be conveniently made through the HappyMom bank account or Venmo. (Account information provided separately during consultation)
step05Title: Step 05. Postpartum Caregiver Selection and Matching
step05Desc: Reflecting the mother's preferences and requests, we match selected experts that HappyMom is proud of. We arrange for you to greet them in advance through a phone call or meeting with the selected caregiver.
step06Desc: An experienced postpartum caregiver is dispatched to the mother's home at the promised date and time to begin premium postpartum care service.
outOfStateDesc: Service application procedures and costs for states outside California may vary by region. We provide detailed guidance on customized information optimized for the mother through separate consultation.
insuranceDesc: We fully support the issuance of necessary documents and receipts for mothers using workplace welfare insurance benefits such as Carrot Fertility.
scheduleDesc: If there is a change in the expected delivery date, please contact HappyMom immediately upon hospital admission so we can adjust the caregiver assignment without any disruption to the schedule.
